title: Retire unused platform theme formatter and generation structure mapper

source.ref: Exact runtime graph and actual janitor read/action/preview consumers

detail: After explicit platform DB CSS reader and generation-axis retirement, lib/theme/css.ts and structure.ts had no code/CLI/dynamic importers beyond their own unit tests. Remove only these helper/test pairs and correct historical references. Preserve saved theme validation, cookie/Space identifiers, janitor-gated create/update/delete actions, admin-read validation and actual inline light/dark/feel preview. Strengthen the surviving consequence guard to reject helper restoration, lost janitor read/write validation and lost preview token application. Existing validation/action boundary tests and rendered preview mode controls remain required. Active Default/Midnight, Space themes, CSS rules and saved production data are untouched.
